body: Built for off-grid travel and everyday comfort, this 2025 Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD camper van in the El Capitan build tier includes premium power, solar, air conditioning, diesel heat, Starlink internet, a full kitchen, indoor shower, convertible sleeping setup, and rugged exterior upgrades.

Inside, the van features gray and black finishes, stained wood accents, shiplap walls, custom tile, dimmable lighting, smart storage, and a comfortable dinette-to-bed layout built for life on the road.
